findings.issue: 55 example WebP images in each frontend copy (110 files total) have CRLF bytes converted to LF by the broad text attributes, corrupting their RIFF payloads. All 55 changed canonical images fail Pillow decoding while the base versions decode successfully. Restore the base bytes and mark WebP assets binary so Git cannot corrupt them again.

needs-human: Passing record.seed now makes setGenerationSettings() lock a saved positive seed. This changes history regeneration from a new variant to fixed-seed reproduction, conflicting with Issue #9's variant expectation and README.md:23; the separate composition-lock action already supports reproduction. Confirm the intended API/UI behavior before changing the seed policy or its documentation.

summary: Restored 110 corrupted example WebP files to the PR base bytes and marked WebP assets binary, with two decoding regressions proven red before the fix and green afterward. The full offline gate passes (240 Python tests plus 26 subtests, 78 frontend tests, 138 Worker tests, browser QA, sync and syntax checks), and the Worker bundle builds successfully. needs-human: fixed-seed history reproduction conflicts with the issue's variant expectation and README; that policy remains unchanged and real-provider/Preview acceptance is unverified.
